question: What is the pH of normal milk?
solution:
The pH range of fresh milk is **6.7 - 6.9**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__**

 
• Fresh milk has a pH ranging from 6.4 to 6.9.
 
• Over time, the pH of milk lowers further and it becomes even more acidic as the bacteria in the milk converts the sugar lactose into lactic acid.
 
• pH is a determined value, similar to temperature, based on a defined scale.
 
• pH stands for the** “potenz of hydrogen”** and the numerical value of pH is determined by the molar concentration of hydrogen ions (H+)³.
 
• The higher concentration of H+ ions is acidic nature.
